name: Shure MV7 / MV7+
author: Joel Gaff, Jr.
description: Control Shure MV7 and MV7+ microphones from the bar with model-specific gain, Auto Level, headphone mix, processing and presets. Driven by shurectl --json --follow.

barWidget.description: Mute, gain, headphone mix, processing and presets for Shure MV7 and MV7+ (needs shurectl with --json)

schema.label: shurectl binary
schema.description: Path to a shurectl that has --json (empty: ~/.local/bin/shurectl, then shurectl on PATH).

schema.label: Poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often the mic is read so its own mute button and MOTIV app changes show up.

schema.label: Scroll step (%)
schema.description: How much scrolling changes the headphone mix: toward computer audio on MV7, or mic volume on MV7+.
